description: The file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application, handling fragment management and user interactions within the activity. It manages the creation, setup, and fragment transactions for a master-detail interface involving HeadlinesFragment and ArticleFragment.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity extends FragmentActivity, orchestrating fragment interactions and UI setup for a master-detail layout in an Android app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and adds the initial HeadlinesFragment if not restoring from previous state.

methods.name: onArticleSelected
methods.description: Handles user selection of an article headline, updates ArticleFragment if present, or replaces fragments to display the selected article.
